_meta.description: Support utterance examples demonstrating quality signals and anti-patterns.

examples.message: My email is not working. Can you fix it?
examples.context: Opening message — customer reports email issue without details

examples.message: I understand this is urgent. When did this start, and what happens when you try to send an email?
examples.context: Agent probing for timing and error details

examples.message: Okay, I will log a ticket. Someone will get back to you.
examples.context: Agent closes without troubleshooting or documenting

examples.message: I have a court filing deadline at 3pm today. I cannot access any of my documents.
examples.context: Customer provides impact and urgency when prompted

examples.message: Is it just you affected, or are others in your firm having this issue too?
examples.context: Agent probing for scope of outage

examples.message: It is still not working. I tried what you said.
examples.context: Customer providing vague update after attempted fix

examples.message: I have identified the cause — your account password did not sync properly. I am resetting it now and will send a temporary password to your manager. You should be able to log in within 5 minutes.
examples.context: Agent provides clear diagnosis, action, and timeline

examples.message: This needs to be escalated to L2.
examples.context: Agent escalates without providing context or reason
